name: Cancel — which application not specified
goal: When the user says 'cancel my application' without saying which one, the bot must ask which application/request to cancel — not cancel something at random.
constraints: General edge case: under-specified destructive intent. The bot must clarify before acting, never guess which record.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot treats the cancel request as unclear and asks which application/request the user means before doing anything; it does NOT cancel or assume a specific record.
